## 1. Redaction log

| # | Item | Timestamps | Handling |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Browser chrome — tab strip, address bar, 2 extension icons | throughout | **Crop** to page content (`crop=1920:880:0:200`) — removes items 1 and 5 together |
| 2 | Phone number `0419 570 156` | 0:21–0:34, 1:52–1:58 | **Blur.** Outside ACMA's reserved fictitious range — the demo seed uses `0491 570 156`, so this is a transposition that could be a real number |
| 3 | Live invite code | 1:12–1:40 | **Blur.** Still redeemable at the time of review |
| 4 | "Complimentary — no charge until further notice" | 2:05–2:11 | **Keep**, with small print under the embed — it is account state, not identifying |
| 5 | Checkout session URL in address bar | 1:44 | Removed by the crop |

Item 2 is the one that justified the frame sweep: at playback speed it reads as ordinary demo data.

## 2. Proof of redaction

Sensitive crops taken from the *unredacted* original (phone field, code field), then every output frame tested:

```text
frames checked: 4,032
max template-match score, phone field: 0.31   (threshold 0.75)
max template-match score, code field:  0.28
PASS — no frame retains either field
```

The first attempt failed at 0.91 on frames 1,340–1,390: the contact panel scrolls, and a fixed rectangle lost the field. Re-placed by template matching per frame, then re-run.

## 3. Encoding report

| | Source | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Size | 15.9 MB | **3.3 MB** |
| Video | fixed bitrate | `libx264 -crf 20 -preset slow` |
| Audio | present | dropped (`-an`) |
| Index | at end | `+faststart` (front) |

`volumedetect` reported `mean_volume: -91.0 dB` — digital silence, so the track was dropped rather than shipped empty. ffmpeg came from `npm install ffmpeg-static ffprobe-static` into a scratch folder; no system install and no admin rights needed.

## 4. Embed markup

```html
<video src="/assets/invite-walkthrough.mp4?v=1"
       poster="/assets/invite-walkthrough-poster.jpg"
       width="1920" height="880" controls preload="metadata"></video>
```

`?v=1` because `/assets/*` carries a 7-day cache — bump it whenever the file is replaced.

## 5. Text alternative

Published directly beneath the video (WCAG 1.2.1 — the video is silent, so this is required, not optional):

1. Open **Settings → Team** from the main menu.
2. Select **Invite a colleague**.
3. Enter their work email address.
4. Choose their role — **Member** or **Administrator**.
5. Select **Send invitation**. They receive an email with a join link.
6. The invitation appears under **Pending** until they accept.

> The account shown has a complimentary billing period. Standard pricing applies to new accounts.

## 6. Maintenance note

Re-record and re-sweep whenever the invite flow changes screens or field labels; update the step list in the same change. The step list is the part most likely to drift, because it keeps working visually long after the wording in the product has moved on.
